mapper.sql: SELECT ud.user_id FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN user_dept ud ON gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' INNER JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id AND dc.ancestor_id = gt.subject_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = dc.descendant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE gt.subject_type = 'DEPT'

SELECT up.user_id FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN user_post up ON gt.subject_type = 'POST' AND up.post_id = gt.subject_id INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON sp.id = up.post_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE gt.subject_type = 'POST'
